hits.title: Behavioral Couplings: From Formation to Behavioral Emergence in Language Models
hits.abstract_snippet: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) can induce behaviors beyond those explicitly targeted. For example, training a model to respond more warmly can make it more sycophantic, and training it to write insecure code can cause broad misalignment on prompts unrelated to coding. hits.title: Beyond the Answer: Student-Conditioned Trace Construction for Reasoning Distillation

hits.title: Quality-of-Transmission Estimation in Quantum Networks: Compute, Simulate, or Learn?
